# whatmodel.sh · find the best decision models you can run

[llm](../README.md) · [image](image.md) · [video](video.md) · [tts](tts.md) · [stt](stt.md) · **decision**

updated 2026-11-03 02:37 UTC · 357 models · scores combine 238 benchmarks · [how it works](method.md) · [benchmark your machine](https://whatmodel.sh/bench) · [interactive version](https://whatmodel.sh/decision)

Run `curl "whatmodel.sh/decision?mac=$(sysctl -n hw.memsize)"` to see what your Mac can run, or `curl whatmodel.sh/decision` for this list in your terminal.

<details><summary>Linux, Windows and common machines</summary>

```sh
curl "whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=$(awk '/MemT/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)&vram=$(nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>/dev/null || cat /sys/class/drm/card*/device/mem_info_vram_total 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1)"   # Linux
curl.exe "whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=$((gcim Win32_ComputerSystem).TotalPhysicalMemory)&vram=$(nvidia-smi -i 0 --query-gpu=memory.total --format=csv,noheader,nounits 2>$null)"   # Windows
```

[16GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=16&gpu=apple) · [32GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=32&gpu=apple) · [64GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=64&gpu=apple) · [128GB Mac](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=128&gpu=apple) · [12GB graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=32&gpu=card&vram=12) · [24GB graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=64&gpu=card&vram=24) · [16GB, no graphics card](https://whatmodel.sh/decision?ram=16&gpu=none)
